# Research question

Describe the specific scientific question, objectives,
and hypotheses or exploratory aims.

# Data and study area

Describe the datasets, study area, sampling design,
spatial and temporal coverage, and data limitations.

# Methods

Document preprocessing, analytical methods, model
specifications, parameters, software versions, and
validation procedures.

# Results

Present quantitative findings supported by actual
R/Python computations.

Include figures, tables, uncertainty estimates,
and references to the corresponding output files.

# Discussion

Interpret the results in relation to the scientific
question and verified literature.

Distinguish observations, interpretations, plausible
mechanisms, and speculation.

# Limitations

Describe methodological limitations, uncertainty,
potential biases, and unresolved questions.

# Conclusions

Summarize the principal findings without introducing
unsupported claims.

# Reproducibility

Document the input datasets, scripts, software
environment, execution instructions, and output paths.

Restore and validate the repository environments from the repository root:

```text
./scripts/bootstrap-env.sh
./scripts/check-env.sh
```

Render this report only with:

```text
./scripts/render-analysis.sh analysis/<TASK-ID>_<concise-name>
```

Record the Git revision, exact tool and package versions, parameters, platform,
and SHA-256 hashes of `uv.lock` and `renv.lock` in
`provenance/environment.json`. The report must identify all input data and
scientific output paths separately.
